sn9.4:2.1: The idiom _viya me khāyati_ (“seems to me”) is used for suppositions, so it must refer to the presumed dissatisfaction of the mendicants, rather than the disappointment of the deity.
sn9.4:4.4: A Brahmanical renunciate is said to wander “without fire or abode” (_anagniraniketa_, Manusmṛti 6.25, 6.43).
